about: Use class of every building in the map tiles (van), in each tile’s B order (project decision). u: h homes, s shops and food, o offices and business, i industry and warehouses, p schools / health / community, x other, u not recorded. s (source): o OpenStreetMap places inside the outline, l City business licences inside it, z the City zone at its centre (zone -> class our reading), - none. Street-level points: a mixed building reads by what is at street level.
